query:
The group seems to operate on an understanding that whenever someone is in Manchester, they show up to Sunday dinner at Margaret and Derek's — it's treated as a given. Does that expectation hold equally for all of them, or does someone have a meaningfully different relationship to it?

Options:
A. Jamie
B. Rachel
C. Callum
D. Sophie
context:
[1] (about=Callum, core, t14 @2026-02-22T18:44:00) Will be in Manchester for Easter.
[2] (about=Callum, said_by=Rachel, profile, t5 @2026-01-25T11:30:00) Rachel acknowledges that attending the February weekend is a stretch for Callum but asks him to come.
[3] (about=Derek, episodic, t8 @2026-02-01T10:16:00) Took the tram in this morning. Salford Quays in twenty minutes. No traffic.
[4] (about=Jamie, core, t12 @2026-02-15T15:22:00) Invites Callum to stay for a weekend in Ancoats to get out of Edinburgh.
[5] (about=Jamie, core, t10 @2026-02-08T20:54:00) Saturday cook-up will go down in family history; dad eating experimental food without complaining is a landmark event.
[6] (about=Margaret, core, t2 @2026-01-11T11:05:00) Wants Jamie to come over for dinner soon to hear everything about the album.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Margaret, group-interaction, t8 @2026-02-01T10:11:00) Margaret will make a big pot of something for Friday night dinner.
[8] (about=Rachel, core, t5 @2026-01-25T11:30:00) Proposes full family weekend at Mum and Dad's in February half term, will organise it, wants everyone there including Callum.
[9] (about=Rachel, core, t6 @2026-01-25T11:34:00) Proposes full family weekend at Mum and Dad's in February half term, will organise it, wants everyone together.
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Rachel, group-interaction, t6 @2026-01-25T11:34:00) Family weekend agreed for weekend of February 14th (Friday evening through Sunday) at Mum and Dad's; Rachel will organise food logistics.
[11] (about=Sophie, core, t2 @2026-01-11T11:05:00) Planning a visit to Jamie's flat week after next (around 2026-01-25), will bring food.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Sophie, group-interaction, t8 @2026-02-01T10:11:00) Weekend plan confirmed: Friday evening arrivals, Saturday full day together, Sunday until mid-afternoon.
agent_answer:
**C. Callum** — the Sunday-dinner expectation does **not** hold equally for him.

Callum is the one with a meaningfully different relationship to the family gatherings in Manchester: Rachel explicitly acknowledges that attending the February weekend is a *stretch* for him, yet asks him to come anyway. He is the one who needs to travel down (he's based in Edinburgh — Jamie invites him to stay in Ancoats "to get out of Edinburgh"), whereas Jamie, Rachel, and Sophie all appear to be regular, fully-included participants without that friction.
